title: Hussain ka ghum manaiye
body:
1. Hussain zaate azeem hai
Kareem ibne kareem hai
Isi ke khadmo me aayiye
hussain ka gham manayiye
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Hussain hain waarise nabi
hussain hain dilbare ali
Sukoo is dar se paayiye
hussain ka gham manayiye
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Milenge is dar se nemate
yahin se milti hai jannatein
Muraade sab leke jayiye
hussain ka gham manayiye
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Buland hota hai martaba
dua e deti hai fathema
Aza ki majlis me aayiye
hussain ka gham manayiye
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Hussain ibne ali ka gham
khasam khuda ki hai mohtaram
Har ek gham bhool jajiye
hussain ka gham manayiye
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Namaaze gham ki ye shaan hai
aza ka farsh aasmaan hai
Musalla fauran bichaayiye
hussain ka gham manayiye
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Hai karbala kabaye yaqeen
zameen aisi koi nahi
Yahi jabeene jhukayiye
hussain ka gham manayiye
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Yaha ki mitti me hai shifa
ye hai waseela najaat ka
Yaha  pe aankhe bichayuye
hussain ka gham manayiye
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Aza ke aanso hai raushni
ye ashkh dete hai zindagi
Musalsil anso bahayiye
hussain ka gham manayiye
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Uthaaye abbas ka alam
badhaayi liye bas yuhi khadam
Payaam ye dete jayiye
hussain ka gham manayiye
<<DIVIDER>>
11. Bahega is gham me gar lahu
to peshe rab honge surkh roo
Khud apni azmat badhaayiye
hussain ka gham manayiye
<<DIVIDER>>
12. Ye jhoola taboot aur alam
nishaniya sab hai mohtaram
Yaha sar apna jhukaayiye
hussain ka gham manayiye
<<DIVIDER>>
13. Jawaan beta juda hua
shaheed  asgar b hi hogaya
Hai zikr pyaso ka aayiye
hussain ka gham manayiye
<<DIVIDER>>
14. Raha na abbas sa jari
kamar hui kham hussain ki
Usi ka matam hai aayiye
hussain ka gham manayiye
<<DIVIDER>>
15. Museebate door kijiye
hussain ka naam lijiye
Pukariye azmaayiye
hussain ka gham manayiye
<<DIVIDER>>
16. Rasheed ki hai ye arzoo
payam goonjhi ye chaarsoo
Ye nawha sab ko sunayiye
hussain ka gham manayiye
